pharma.title: NPPA Caps Prices Of 42 New Drug Formulations, Including Diabetes, BP And Women’s Health Medicines
pharma.summary: The National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority (NPPA) notified ceiling prices for 42 new drug formulations. The capped formulations cover critical therapeutic segments including diabetes, hypertension, and women's healthcare.

pharma.title: India’s SS Innovations performs 10,000-km robotic telesurgery between Australia and Indore
pharma.summary: Indian MedTech company SS Innovations successfully demonstrated a 10,000-kilometer robotic telesurgery connecting surgical operators in Australia to a patient system in Indore. This marks a major milestone in ultra-long-distance remote robotic surgical procedures.

pharma.title: Lupin Receives U.S. FDA Approval for Glycerol Phenylbutyrate Oral Liquid
pharma.summary: Pharma major Lupin received official approval from the U.S. FDA for its generic Glycerol Phenylbutyrate Oral Liquid. The medication is indicated for management of urea cycle disorders.

pharma.title: India's crackdown on fentanyl precursor exports draws US praise amid global opioid crisis
pharma.summary: The United States praised Indian regulatory and enforcement agencies for tightening oversight on the export of precursor chemicals used in illicit fentanyl manufacturing. The measure forms part of broader global anti-narcotics cooperation.

national.title: Kulveer Singh Yadav Appointed Government Nominee Director on Hindustan Copper Board
national.summary: The Ministry of Mines nominated Kulveer Singh Yadav as the Government Nominee Director on the Board of Hindustan Copper Limited. The appointment reinforces state oversight in central public sector mining undertakings.

national.title: Indian esports scales up, but still awaits its 1983 Cricket World Cup moment
national.summary: Industry analyses highlighted rapid market growth and rising viewership across Indian esports platforms. Stakeholders emphasized the need for major international titles and grassroots infrastructure to establish mainstream institutional recognition.

international.title: India-UAE, India-U.S. among top 10 migration corridors in 2024: UN
international.summary: A UN global migration assessment reported that the India-UAE and India-U.S. corridors remain among the top ten largest bilateral migration flows worldwide. The findings reflect sustained demand for cross-border labour and skilled diaspora movement.

international.title: "Humanitarian Effort": US Links Hormuz 'Freedom' To India's LPG Needs
international.summary: The United States highlighted the importance of securing freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz to ensure uninterrupted LPG shipments to India. The corridor remains vital for India's domestic energy supply security.

economy.title: Indian firms go big in America: Pour in $16.4 billion, create over 70,000 jobs across US
economy.summary: A corporate investment survey revealed that Indian enterprises have invested $16.4 billion across US state economies. These investments have directly generated over 70,000 American jobs in sectors ranging from IT to manufacturing.

economy.title: 4% inflation target remains appropriate for India: RBI Dy Governor Poonam Gupta
economy.summary: Reserve Bank of India officials stated that retaining the core headline inflation target of 4% remains appropriate for maintaining long-term macroeconomic stability. The Monetary Policy Committee continues to closely monitor volatile crude oil price risks.

economy.title: How India-New Zealand FTA creates new global pathways for Indian talent
economy.summary: Economic analysis of the proposed trade mechanisms between India and New Zealand underlined enhanced mobility frameworks for skilled Indian professionals. Key service sectors expected to benefit include technology, healthcare, and education.

science.title: Ministry of Information and Broadcasting Launches AI Skill Programme, 15,000 Students to Receive Scholarships
science.summary: The Ministry of Information and Broadcasting announced an artificial intelligence skill development initiative targeting youth. Under the program, 15,000 selected students will receive full scholarships for advanced technical training.

science.title: DST's decade of reforms driving India's economic growth: Jitendra Singh
science.summary: Union Minister Jitendra Singh highlighted a decade of structural reforms by the Department of Science and Technology (DST) aimed at boosting R&D commercialization. The initiatives have scaled deep-tech startups and strengthened institutional research facilities.

environment.title: India shifts climate priorities as global uncertainty grows
environment.summary: Policy reviews indicate India is refining its climate adaptation framework to focus heavily on resilient infrastructure and local renewable supply chains. The shift aims to cushion domestic green transition goals against global market volatility.

sports.title: Indian sports wrap, May 5: India U-18 men’s and women’s hockey teams to play series against Australia in Bhopal
sports.summary: Hockey India confirmed that Bhopal will play host to the upcoming international bilateral series between the India U-18 men's and women's teams and Australia. The series serves as a key development platform for junior national players.

awards_honours.title: Lajpat Nagar Wins Best Delhi Metro Station Award, Najafgarh Best Metro Depot
awards_honours.summary: Delhi Metro Rail Corporation awarded Lajpat Nagar the title of Best Metro Station for operational excellence and cleanliness. Najafgarh was awarded the Best Metro Depot recognition.

awards_honours.title: Usha Mangeshkar, Hariharan, Dilip Joshi and many other celebs honoured at Newsmakers Achievers Awards
awards_honours.summary: Prominent cultural figures including veteran singers Usha Mangeshkar, Hariharan, and actor Dilip Joshi were honored at the Newsmakers Achievers Awards. The event recognized outstanding lifetime contributions in music, television, and public entertainment.

defence.title: Bengaluru startup’s Drishti satellite boosts India’s defence edge
defence.summary: A Bengaluru-based deep-tech startup successfully deployed the 'Drishti' Earth observation satellite into orbit. The satellite is designed to enhance space-based high-resolution surveillance and defense intelligence capabilities.

defence.title: India’s Strike Power Crisis: Ageing Jaguar Fleet Faces Collapse as “Super Su-30MKI” Emerges as High-Stakes Replacement
defence.summary: Defense reviews highlighted the urgency of upgrading the IAF's Su-30MKI fighter fleet to the 'Super Sukhoi' configuration as legacy Jaguar deep-strike aircraft near phase-out. The modernization plan focuses on upgraded avionics, radars, and long-range indigenous weaponry.

schemes_appointments.title: Middle East conflict: Govt launches Rs 18,100 crore credit guarantee scheme; MSMEs, airlines to get Rs 2.
schemes_appointments.summary: The Central Government launched an ₹18,100 crore credit guarantee scheme to assist sectors impacted by Middle East trade disruptions. Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) and commercial airlines will receive liquidity assistance under the window.

schemes_appointments.title: Kumar Mangalam Birla appointed as Non-Executive Chairman of Vodafone Idea
schemes_appointments.summary: Industrialist Kumar Mangalam Birla was re-appointed as the Non-Executive Chairman of telecom operator Vodafone Idea. He succeeds Ravinder Takkar following a restructuring of the company's board leadership.

important_days.title: May 5th | World Portuguese Language Day Celebrated Globally
important_days.summary: World Portuguese Language Day was celebrated globally on May 5th to mark the global reach and cultural significance of the Portuguese language across CPLP member states.

mcqs.q: How many new drug formulations had their retail prices capped by the National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority (NPPA) on 05 May 2026?
mcqs.explanation: The NPPA notified price caps for 42 new drug formulations covering diabetes, hypertension, and women's health.

mcqs.q: Who was appointed as the Non-Executive Chairman of Vodafone Idea in May 2026?
mcqs.explanation: Kumar Mangalam Birla took over as the Non-Executive Chairman of Vodafone Idea, succeeding Ravinder Takkar.

mcqs.q: Which Delhi Metro station was awarded the 'Best Delhi Metro Station' in May 2026?
mcqs.explanation: Lajpat Nagar won the Best Delhi Metro Station award, while Najafgarh secured the Best Metro Depot award.

mcqs.q: What is the financial outlay of the credit guarantee scheme launched by the Central Government to support MSMEs and airlines amid Middle East trade disruptions?
mcqs.explanation: The Government launched an ₹18,100 crore credit guarantee scheme to provide liquidity support to affected MSMEs and airlines.

mcqs.q: Which Indian city was chosen to host the India U-18 men's and women's hockey bilateral series against Australia in May 2026?
mcqs.explanation: Hockey India confirmed Bhopal as the host city for the India U-18 hockey series against Australia.
